_doc: The groomer's readiness rules (DRE-6665). One record per rule, in the order a card's rows are listed. `applied_by` names what applies the rule: `groom_readiness` for the five evaluated in scripts/groom_readiness.py, `held_repo_rows` for the parked repo, which scripts/groomer.py removes from the offer under DRE-3403. `reason` and `condition` are plain English, rendered once per card the rule found and joined with `; ` and ` and ` (roll-up-parent renders once, naming every child epic). Placeholders: {names} the card id the rule found, {state} that card's lane, {files} the shared files in backticks, {why} why a named card could not be read, {question} the quoted question of undecided-question, {repo} the parked repo. `python3 scripts/groom_readiness.py check` fails when these ids and the evaluators disagree.

rules.epic_reason: its ranked read waits on {names} ({state}), an epic with work left to build
rules.unread_reason: its ranked read waits on {names}, which could not be read this morning ({why})

rules.reason: its epic {names} is in {state}, not In Progress

rules.condition: that section is settled on the card

rules.reason: a roll-up parent — its child epics: {names}
rules.condition: never — its child epics are offered on their own
